# domeneshop Provider

Manage Domeneshop DNS records and HTTP forwards.

Generate an API token and secret at [domeneshop.no/admin?view=api](https://www.domeneshop.no/admin?view=api).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    domeneshop = {
      source  = "sebastka/domeneshop"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are read from DOMENESHOP_TOKEN and DOMENESHOP_SECRET when the
# provider block leaves them out — the recommended setup, so they never land
# in your configuration or your state file.
provider "domeneshop" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.domeneshop.no/v0`. May also be set with the `DOMENESHOP_BASE_URL` environment variable.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Domeneshop API secret. May also be set with the `DOMENESHOP_SECRET` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Domeneshop API token. May also be set with the `DOMENESHOP_TOKEN` environment variable, which is the recommended way to keep it out of your configuration.
